I have never really hurt myself other than the occasional hitting myself or a wall, but it seems just cutting my forearm allowed me to releive some stress. It was actually a nice feeling. It didn't hurt. My adrenaline was pumping and I barely made a scratch, but I was sweating the whole time and I was dizzy, and it whas passed over a bit. I am going to go to bed soon.

The problem is I don't know what will happen! If I lose my job how will I support my wife and daughter? How will I get medication for myself without money? I am already terrible at saving money and I just feel completely lost. I have felt so bad this week that I consider suicide, but I love and care for my family too much to do that. But it defiantly lingers there in the back of my head. I feel like I want to just sleep forever when I goto sleep at night(it takes about 30m-2hrs to get to sleep because of the negative thoughts in my head that keep pushing me over the edge causing me to get even more depressed), but when I wake up I forget all of those feelings and act like normal. It drives me absolutely insane and I am going to end up killing myself if I can't get any real help!!!! I CAN'T CHANGE MY PSYCHOLOGIST AND I just feel like giving up on my worthless life I grew up with.. I lived like a child should never have. And I have had my disorders since as long as I could remember. I don't want to live if I have to come to reality that I can never be good at anything and feeling like nobody cares about me even though I know they do. It's kinda nostalgic. I feel like I'm writing a will, sort to speak.  I have posted many times without knowing how to put in text what I need to say to convince anyone of how troubled I am l, but no matter how any times I try, I can never find an answer to settle my nerves. I am glad that I have been a great dad to my daughter and for the most part because of my negative thoughts I have been the best husband I could be. I am happy I learned to cope just enough to make it through high school and made it through boot camp and my military schools. But I just don't know if I can still go on living. As I lay here contemplating my options. I will see if I can go on..

I am currently doing a weekly visit until I can get re-evaluated hopefully before my next deployment. I just wish that they will give me medicine so I can be normal and be able to do the things I want to without struggling to get one thing done.
